I'll think through this as the farmer, then give the plan.

---

My reasoning:

I have 9 mu and four crops to manage. I split my land like I did last year. About 5 mu for wheat-maize rotation — that is the main business, feeds my family and sells some. Then 2 mu for cotton because the price is okay and I know how to grow it. And 2 mu for watermelon, near the road so I can sell to people passing.

For wheat, I plant improved variety seed I buy from the town dealer — Jimai kind, what most neighbors use here. I put down two bags of compound fertilizer (15-15-15) before plowing, that is about 40 kg per mu, so around 6 kg nitrogen, 6 kg phosphorus, 6 kg potassium from that. Then in spring when wheat turns green, I topdress one bag of urea per mu, that gives another 20 kg nitrogen roughly. So total nitrogen about 15 kg nitrogen for wheat counting urea at around 46 percent. I water 3 times — before winter, at green-up, and when the grain is filling. If pests come I spray twice. Rotary tillage because I hire the tractor from the village. Last year I got 450 kg per mu so I expect same.

For maize after wheat, I do not plow, just clean the stubble and plant directly with the seeder. Hybrid seed, Zhengdan 958 or similar, everyone uses it. I put compound fertilizer at planting, about one and half bags per mu, and topdress urea when maize is knee-high. Total nitrogen around 18 kg per mu. I irrigate 2 times if rain is not enough. Spray for borer once, maybe twice if I see worms. Yield 550 kg per mu usually.

For cotton, I use improved seed with the Bt thing in it, so I spray less. I put more potassium because cotton needs it for the bolls. About 15 kg nitrogen, 7 kg phosphorus, 10 kg potassium. Water 3 times. Still need to spray 4 times for aphids and other bugs even with Bt seed. Plow the cotton land properly. Yield around 250 kg seed cotton.

Watermelon takes the most care and most water. I use improved seed, buy small plants from the market. Put lots of manure plus some compound fertilizer — about 12 kg nitrogen, 10 kg phosphorus, 18 kg potassium because sweetness needs potassium. Water 5 times, spray 4 times for wilt and bugs. Plow deep. Yield maybe 3500 kg per mu if weather is good.

I do not change much from last year because what worked, worked. Fertilizer is expensive but losing yield is worse.
